districts.name: Tokyo City
districts.perk: +2 VP at the start of your turn

districts.name: Tokyo Bay
districts.perk: +1 VP and +1 Energy at the start of your turn
districts.drawback: Cards cost +1 Energy while docked here

districts.name: Shinjuku Crossing
districts.perk: +2 Energy at the start of your turn

districts.name: Imperial Palace Gardens
districts.perk: Heal 1 HP at the end of your turn
districts.drawback: You cannot buy cards while sheltering here

notes: At least one monster must remain outside Tokyo: active districts = min(playerCount - 1, 4). When attacking from outside, if any active district is vacant the attacker must occupy one (player chooses among vacancies). Occupants never take damage from a monster inside their own district; monsters in Tokyo are never damaged by other Tokyo monsters.
